item.description: - Switched CI and default non-Developer-ID macOS release signing in `scripts/lib/signing.sh`, `scripts/package-release.sh`, and `.github/workflows/release.yml` from a self-signed X.509 certificate (`SAGA_CODESIGN_P12_BASE64`) to ad-hoc (`-`) signing so quarantined release downloads work cleanly with macOS Sequoia / Tahoe's **Privacy & Security → Open Anyway** flow without `syspolicyd` / `amfid` rejecting an untrusted X.509 certificate chain (`CSSMERR_TP_NOT_TRUSTED`) when loading `@rpath` frameworks (`Sparkle.framework`, `Ifrit.framework`). - Added `com.apple.security.cs.disable-library-validation` and `com.apple.security.network.client` (`<true/>`) to `Saga/Saga/Config/Saga.entitlements` (matching `GatteyPhotos.local.entitlements`) and required `--entitlements` when signing `Saga.app` in `scripts/package-release.sh` (with `ENABLE_APP_SANDBOX=NO` during `CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO` builds). - Updated release packaging comments in `scripts/package-release.sh`, `scripts/lib/signing.sh`, and `scripts/export-ci-secrets.sh` to document ad-hoc (`-`) + Sparkle 2 EdDSA update verification.
